pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark brown regions with relatively sharp-edged gradients and irregular, multi-sided geometries. Patch size is heterogeneous, exhibiting larger spatial areas on the upper flank and transitioning to smaller, more fragmented units toward the posterior and lower ventral regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored interstitial pathways forming a connected graph. The pathways exhibit consistent pixel thickness with clearly defined junction nodes where three or more corridors intersect, creating a tessellated pattern across the visible torso.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette visible along the upper neck and shoulder ridge against the background luminance.
